# Atlas

The late game (post stage 20) has received a complete overhaul. At stage 20, you now receive the Connection Orb. The Connection Orb allows you to browse the Atlas, a new tree-based progression system that let you explore different paths to unlock the many new late-game mechanics we added this patch, and reconnect with the residents of Treasure Town.

The Atlas is inspired by the Connection Orb mechanic from Pokémon Super Mystery Dungeon. The number of paths you can follow is enormous. Our goal is to make every game even more unique. The same team composition will have a different outcome depending on the Atlas path you choose. All the team caps have been raised, and the game can be turned around at any stage with much more comeback options available to everyone.

# Stellar

We introduce what will be the final 32th synergy to Pokémon Auto Chess: STELLAR

This special synergy is only given through special items and Pokémon. Its effect is to increase by 1 the synergy level of all active synergies, and Stellar Pokémon benefit from the effects of all active synergies. Stellar cannot be a symbol on portals. A STELLAR_GEM exists but cannot be sold by Sableye town encounter.

# New monthly event: Rainbow Peak

> Thanks to bigweff for this community challenge idea

Climb Rainbow Peak, one synergy at a time! Finish at 1st place in a Classic game while your currently highlighted synergy is at its max tier to earn a point and move to the next synergy. Do it with every synergy and finish with a win with STELLAR active to complete the event!

# Changes to Synergies

- Fire 8 rework: no longer gives Fire Shard. After 10 seconds, the whole board is set on fire and BURN all Pokémon, allies and enemies, and your FIRE Pokémon gain 15 SPEED.
- Baby 7: Golden eggs now give an EMERA when hatched. Removed the limit of max 1 golden egg on bench.

- GOURMET cooking mechanic has been revisited. The cooking process now takes up to 8 seconds to complete, giving you time to move your chef around to properly distribute the dishes to your allies. If the battle is about to start, the cooking time will be reduced and even be instant on the last seconds of the preparation phase. Your chefs now cook immediately when receiving the CHEF_HAT. Dishes made this stage are now removed if the chef loses their hat by deactivating GOURMET synergy or benching the chef. This allows you to freely switch dishes between rounds without having to think one stage ahead.
- A GOURMET GROUND Pokémon can now dig and cook in the same stage. The cooking will be delayed until the Pokémon is done digging.
- Buff FLYING: now dodges the damage that would have dropped them below the HP threshold. Flying 8 Skydive damage: 150 → 200% of ATK
- Buff Monster 8. New effect: When knocking out the last enemy on the board, permanently gain 3 ATK, 10 AP and 10 max HP. (thanks to tegberen)
- Synergies now have a more consistent order accross all places where they are displayed (synergy menu, game history, post-game screen, etc.). The order is based on the synergy level, then in case of tie on the synergy tier, then in case of tie on the amount of Pokémon representing that synergy. This order is also used to clarify the determination of some divergent evolutions (e.g. Meowstic, Gallade/Gardevoir) and some passives (Arceus, Kecleon).

# Changes to Pokemon & Abilities

- 32 new Z-Move abilities have been added to the game, one for each synergy.
- Rework Yveltal:
  - New passive Destruction: when surviving damage below 20% max HP, Yveltal transforms into a Cocoon of Destruction. The cocoon cannot move or attack and transforms back into Yveltal when healed to 50% max HP.
  - Cocoon ability Dark Aura: deals [10,SP] + [50,SP]% of ATK as SPECIAL to enemies within 2 tiles and heals for 15 HP plus 75% of damage dealt.
  - Oblivion Wing now fires a beam that hits the most enemies, dealing [30,50,70,100,SP] SPECIAL to each and healing for 50% of damage dealt.
  - On returning from the cocoon, Yveltal always regains Oblivion Wing and 100 max PP, even if its ability or max PP had been changed.
- Snivy is now in Rare pool. PP 70 → 100. Adjusted stats.
- Turtwig is now in Hatch pool. Adjusted stats.
- Bulbasaur line is now 1-range. Adjusted stats. New ability Mega Drain: Drain all ADJACENT enemies for [10,20,40,80,150,SP] SPECIAL, healing for 50% of the damage dealt.
- Petilil and Liligant are now 2-range. Adjusted stats. Hisui Lilligant remains 1-range.
- New passive to Duosion and Reuniclus: Mitosis. Upon KO, the Pokémon will split into 2 copies of its previous stage of evolution with no items and half its current PP.
- Pirouette Meloetta no longer transforms to Aria Meloetta when put on bench
- Nerf Magic Bounce (Xatu): user gets SILENCE during the effect. Duration: 5 → 4 seconds
- Poison Gas Board effect change: POISON Pokémon are now immune
- Buff Carnivine: partial revert of the 6.8 nerf; Speed: 29 → 40
- Delibird is now ICE/FLYING/GOURMET instead of ICE/FLYING/FIELD ; New dish: LUCKY_EGG
- Rework Dondozo and Tatusigiri:
  - When swallowed by Dondozo, Tatsugiri now also provides 50 max HP in addition to its other stats buffs that depend on its form.
    - Tatsugiri HP: 80 → 50
    - Tatsugiri can no longer eat dishes
    - Tatsugiri no longer takes an item slot when swallowed by Dondozo. Instead it is addes as an _absorbed_ item. Absorbed items cannot be stolen or dropped during battle.
    - RICE now gives 50 max HP instead of 80 SHIELD
    - Change Order Up ability: Dondozo **and the allies who have eaten RICE** gain the bonus stats provided by its commander.
- Rework Lycanroc:
  - Lycanroc Day Form becomes the base form of Lycanroc when evolving Rockruff
    - Lycanroc can transform back to Day form on ZENITH weather
    - Lycanroc also transforms to Night Form on BLOODMOON in addition to NIGHT
    - Lycanroc transforms into Dusk Form on DROUGHT
    - Add FIRE type to Lycanroc Dusk Form
- Nerf Drum Beating (Grookey): removed AP scaling and ability crit on the team-wide speed buff part of the ability.
- Cascoon is no longer regional. Wurmple evolves into Cascoon if POISON synergy is active, or into Silcoon instead.
- Rework Bite: Deal [300,400,500,1000]% of user ATK as SPECIAL to the target and heal the user for [50,SP]% of the damage dealt
- Change ability of Totodile line to Bite instead of Crunch.
- Change ability of Larvitar line to Pursuit instead of Bite. Pursuit: Deal [35,70,140,280,SP] SPECIAL to the target and marks it. If the target subsequently jumps, teleports or FLY_AWAY, jump next to it and cast again immediately.
- Buff Bounsweet line: PP 120 → 90
- Rework Unown-D (DUPE): Transform into a copy of your STRONGEST ally without its items and permanent buffs. PP 100 → 50
- Nerf Unown J (JAWS): Sharpedos no longer held a RAZOR_CLAW
- Change Unown-N (NUKE): No longer consume PP and trigger on-cast effects. Fixed SHIELD amount given not increasing with CRIT_POWER on crit. Clarified description. PP 100 → 80
- Buff Unown-S (SURF): PP 100 → 90
- Change Unown-V (VOLT): No longer consume PP and trigger on-cast effects for each thunder shock. Clarified description. PP 90 → 60
- Change Unown-Y (YOGA): No longer consume PP and trigger on-cast effects. Clarified description.
- Nerf Attack Order (Vespiqueen): base damage [20,40,60,120] → [10,20,30,60] SPECIAL
- Buff Wartortle: DEF/SPE_DEF 3 → 4 ; Buff Blastoise: DEF/SPE_DEF 4 → 6, ATK 20 → 23
- Rework Nightmare (Ghastly): now applies damage to all enemies suffering from a negative status condition instead of just GHOST curse.
- Revert Cosmog and Cosmoem buffs from 6.7.5 and 6.8 HP : 100 → 140 ; Cosmoem HP: 200 → 220 ; evolutiion stacks required: 8 → 10 ; this is due to the increase of selling prices of evolved Pokémon.
- New ability for Paras: Scatters 3 spores around the nearest non POISONED enemy. After 2 seconds, it explodes on nearby ADJACENT enemies dealing [10,20,40,80,SP] SPECIAL, inflicting POISONED for 3s.
- New ability for Milotic: Creates an oceanic swirl around the largest 3x3 group of Pokémon. For 3 seconds, it heals allies in the area for [5,10,15,20,SP] HP and deals [3,6,9,12,SP] SPECIAL to enemies every 0.5 seconds. At the end of the duration, the swirl dissipates, leaving enemies in the area with CHARM for 1 second.
- New ability for Jirachi: Calls down 3 stars in succession, each targeting the ally with the lowest HP%. Each star takes 1.5 seconds to reach its target, and the next star appears as the previous one lands. On impact, grants [10,15,20,25,SP] SHIELD to ADJACENT allies, and applies BURN to ADJACENT enemies for 2 seconds.
- Nerf Alcremie Rainbow Swirl passive: 50 → 30 PP to the decorated ally
- Buff Alcremie Ruby passive: 30 → 40 SPEED to the decorated ally
- Change Alcremie Lemon passive: 40% CRIT_CHANCE → 30% CRIT_CHANCE and 30% CRIT_POWER to the decorated ally. DARK allies now give the Lemon flavor
- Change Alcremie Caramel passive: 80% CRIT_POWER → 80 AP to the decorated ally. SOUND allies now give the Caramel flavor
- New ability for Tentacruel: Stings with 3 waves of toxins in a CONE, dealing [1,2,3,4,SP] SPECIAL each. Each enemy hit receives one effect based on its current status:\n- If not POISONED, inflicts POISONED for [2,SP] seconds.\n- If afflicted with POISONED, inflicts PARALYSIS for [2,SP] seconds.\n- If afflicted with PARALYSIS, inflicts ARMOR_BREAK for [2,SP] seconds.\n- If afflicted with ARMOR_BREAK, inflicts FATIGUE for [2,SP] seconds.
- New ability for Wiscash: Targets the enemy with the most PP within a 2-tile radius, dealing [30,60,120,240,SP] SPECIAL. Damage is doubled if the target stands on a fully dug GROUND hole. Knocks 1 RANGE enemies away, or pulls 2+ RANGE enemies toward the user, and inflicts LOCKED for 2 seconds
- New ability for Cradily: Plants a seed on the target, dealing [4,8,12,16]% of its max HP as SPECIAL damage each second for 5 seconds. Each time it deals damage, heals the ally with the lowest missing HP for the amount dealt.
- Change Stakataka passive Wall of Stone: now locks for 3 seconds instead of until the SHIELD is depleted.
- Wurmple now has NORMAL type
- Ogerpon now has HUMAN type in all its forms
- Buff Roggenrola line: 110 → 100PP
- Change Precipice Blades to: Deal [25,50,100,120,200,SP] SPECIAL to all enemy Pokémon in the same row and column as the user. If the user is facing diagonally, hit both diagonals instead.
- Nerf High horsepower (Mudbray): ability cooldown 100ms → 300ms
- Change Regidraco to be able to cast while not in melee range


# Changes to Items

> Shiny items have long been a subject of debate, some players did not like how much variance they brought to the game. We decided to review the category completely, tuning down their effects a bit, reserving them for the very late game, and replacing many of them with more exciting effects.

- Shiny Items have been renamed to Atlas Items, and are now obtainable only through the Atlas.
- New Atlas Item: Tera Orb - The holder replaced their base types with the STELLAR type
- New Atlas Item: Z-Ring - The holder's max PP is changed to 200 and their ability is changed to the chosen Z-Move ability. Each synergy has a Z-Move ability associated with it.
- New Atlas Item: Looplet - Up to 5 EMERA can be sealed in the looplet, each granting additional stats and effects to the holder. Gain 1 EMERA when acquired.
- Removed Shiny Items: Red Scale (moved to Special), Shiny stone (moved to a town carousel item), Eviolite, Gold Bottle Cap, Absorb Bulb, Sacred Ash
- There are now 10 different sorts of fossil stones. They all work the same as an item component, but now have a unique interaction with Ditto.
- Exp Share is no longer a tool, but a special item given on shiny Stage 15 PvE encounter
- Red Scale rework: no longer gives money, now holdable, gives +100 max HP, 10 ATK, 50 AP, 10 DEF and 10 SPE_DEF (previous stats of Eviolite)
- Repeat Ball is now unholdable and no longer gives SHIELD and SPEED. Unique Pokémon are more frequent in shops and can be found even after Legendaries are found.
- Shiny stone is now considered a synergy stone, given by Kecleon town encounter, on item carousels or by exchanging another synergy stone. Removed base stats and removed its effect of adding a second spotlight on the holder cell.
- New tool: Energy Root: 50 SHIELD ; 50% of all SHIELD received is converted to max HP
- Hatch Bundle Double Up Gift: 5 → 10% chance to get a GOLDEN_EGG
- New Double Up Gifts: EMERA and GOLDEN_EMERA
- Rework Casteliacone dish: In the next fight, get [30,LK]% chance to inflict FREEZE for 2 seconds ON_HIT. The first attack always FREEZE.
- Rework Whipped Dream dish: In the next fight, get [30,LK]% chance to inflict CHARM for 2 seconds ON_HIT. The first attack always CHARM.
- Rework Black Sludge: POISONED the Pokémon that eats it. If it has POISON type, restore 5% of max HP every 2 seconds instead. **In the next fight, get [30,LK]% chance to inflict POISONED for 5 seconds ON_HIT. The first attack always inflicts POISONED.**
- METEORITE and ROTOM_CATALOG now open a choice menu to directly choose the form instead of cycling through the forms.
- Protective pads bonus damage on SHIELD is now capped at 50% of the target SHIELD value

> Nullify Bandanna, when combined with the extra scarves provided by Cinccino and Wooloo, has been the source of several persistent item duplication bugs. After many attempts, we realized that an item crafted with 2 SILK_SCARF was incompatible with the design of the NORMAL synergy, so we have decided to remove this recipe and the item entirely.

- Removed Nullify Bandanna

# Gameplay

- Environmental effects (board effects, tidal wave, ghost curse...) are now displayed in DPS report with their own icon (thanks to tegberen)
- Pokemons given through a choice pick (additional picks, unique...) and Pokemons obtained with gifts or special effects (like Shedinja) no longer require you to have a free space on bench. Instead, they are stored and will appear as soon as you will make space on the bench by selling some Pokémon for example. Note that this does not work for synergy effects like Water fishing rods or Bug nest.
